# gitea_repository_actions_artifact (Data Source)

Fetches metadata for a single repository Actions artifact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_actions_artifact" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
  artifact_id      = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (Number) The artifact ID.
- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `archive_download_url` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `expired` (Boolean)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `size_in_bytes` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `workflow_run_id` (Number)
